results.content: Previously, major winners from the year before the Ryder Cup, along with the Players Championship winner, would be compensated with one point for every $1,000 earned. Now, per the new system, there will be no points given for 2026 results, major or otherwise. Instead, qualification will begin at the 2027 American Express, and last through 31 events, concluding at the BMW Championship in mid-August. [...] The philosophy behind ending points for performance in off-year majors is that it can bolster players who go on to lose their form the next season, potentially saddling a captain with a player who is no longer at his best.
